cohort: Offspring born to mothers with an anorectal malformation (ARM) compared to offspring born to age-matched mothers without ARM, identified from Swedish national registers.
finding: First-born children of mothers with ARM were more commonly small for gestational age and had an ARM more frequently than first-born children of mothers without ARM.
birth_weight: Babies identified as 'lighter' and 'small for gestational age' (SGA); after adjusting for gestational age, weight difference was no longer significant.
gest_age: Median 272 days (mothers with ARM) and 280 days (mothers without ARM).
